query: What items that were on the bed when I was holding the envelope are missing when I later crochet in the same room?

events.description: While the person holds a white envelope/paper beside the bed, the bed visibly holds a “Merry Christmas” sign, rolls of Christmas wrapping paper, a closed laptop, a small green round object, and gold tinsel.

Later, the person crochets in the same bedroom; gold tinsel remains on the bed, but the “Merry Christmas” sign, wrapping-paper rolls, closed laptop, and small green round object are no longer present.
